markets.early_close_condition: If an event described in the Payout Criterion occurs, expiration will be moved to an earlier date and time in accordance with Rule 7.2.
markets.rules_primary: If Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture is the first Millennium Prize Problem solved after Issuance, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A Millennium Prize Problem is considered Solved at the earliest time that any of the following occurs:

A complete proof, disproof, or counterexample addressing the problem as officially formulated is published in a peer-reviewed journal.
The Clay Mathematics Institute or another recognized authoritative academic body officially recognizes in writing that the problem has been resolved by reference to a specific written work.
At least two Source Agencies report that the problem has been proven, disproven, or otherwise resolved by reference to a specific publicly available written work.

If multiple problems have the same Solution Time, each is treated as the next problem Solved and the market resolves to 1/N, where N is the number of tied problems. A qualifying solution ceases to count if, before Expiration, it is formally retracted, withdrawn, repudiated, rescinded, or found to contain an identified and unaddressed error.

markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves VERVE-102 for marketing before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves VERVE-102 after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jan 1, 2030.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves VERVE-102 anyway before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve to Yes.

If VERVE-102 receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve to No immediately.

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jan 1, 2035, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves VERVE-102 after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jan 1, 2035.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves VERVE-102 anyway before Jan 1, 2035, the market will resolve to Yes.

If VERVE-102 receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jan 1, 2035, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jan 1, 2035, the market will resolve to No immediately.

events.title: US nominal GDP growth in 2033

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the MacAskill side is determined to have won.
markets.rules_primary:
If the highest percentage increase in U.S. real GDP per capita over its previous peak for Q3 2026 through Q4 2033 is at least 

15%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market is based on the public challenge agreed upon in August 2026 between the following sides:

MacAskill side (fast growth): William MacAskill, Samuel Albanie and Tom Cohen
Moll side (no fast growth): Benjamin Moll and Andrew Ho

GROWTH CONDITION

The MacAskill side wins if, for any quarter from Q3 2026 through Q4 2033, U.S. real GDP per capita is at least 15% above the previous peak.

For each eligible quarter \(Q\):

The applicable quarterly value is U.S. real GDP per capita for \(Q\).
The previous peak is the highest quarterly U.S. real GDP per capita value reported for any quarter through and including \(Q-4\).
Peak-relative growth is calculated as:

(Quarterly value ÷ previous peak − 1) × 100

The condition is met when the resulting value is at least 15%. Equivalently, real GDP per capita for the applicable quarter must be at least 1.15 times the previous peak.

This peak-relative comparison prevents growth caused solely by a rebound from a recession from qualifying.

DATA SOURCE

Resolution will use the official U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis measure “Real gross domestic product per capita,” published in NIPA Table 7.1 as series A939RX. The series is quarterly, seasonally adjusted and expressed in inflation-adjusted chained dollars.

The series is also displayed by FRED.

The quarterly value and the values used to establish the previous peak will be taken from the same BEA publication or data vintage. Calculations will use the published levels without separately rounding the resulting percentage.

CLOSE CALLS

If a BEA release shows peak-relative growth from 14.5% through 15.5%, inclusive, that quarter will instead be evaluated using BEA’s third estimate for the quarter.

Using the third estimate:

A value of at least 15% satisfies the growth condition.
A value below 15% does not satisfy the growth condition.

Once a quarter is subject to this close-call procedure, its third estimate controls the determination for that quarter.

DETERMINATION

The market resolves to MacAskill side as soon as an eligible quarter satisfies the growth condition.

If no eligible quarter has satisfied the condition when BEA first publishes its estimate for Q4 2033:

The market resolves to MacAskill side if the Q4 2033 result is above 15.5%.
The market resolves to Moll side if the result is below 14.5%.
If the result is from 14.5% through 15.5%, determination will be deferred until BEA publishes its third estimate for Q4 2033.

Once the market has been determined, subsequent revisions will not change the result.

The calculation does not require determining whether AI caused the reported growth. “Per capita” refers only to the human population. Resolution is based on the criteria above and does not depend on whether the participants concede, make the agreed payments or subsequently amend their private arrangement.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods and services deficit for calendar year 2032 is strictly above $500 billion dollars, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the nominal goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis. It will not use the goods-only deficit, the advance goods report, the December monthly deficit, or inflation-adjusted trade data.

Because the agencies generally report the balance as a negative number, the market will use the absolute size of the deficit. For example, an annual trade balance of −$800.1 billion constitutes a trade deficit of $800.1 billion.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2032. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.
markets.title: Will the U.S. goods and services deficit for 2032 be above $500 billion?

The Expiration Value will be the first-published annual percent change in real GDP for 2031 from BEA’s GDP release, expected with the advance estimate of Q4 2031 GDP in early 2032. markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the World Bank reports that the global account ownership in the next Global Findex release is above 80%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the percentage reported for “World” under the World Bank indicator “Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider (% of population ages 15+),” series code FX.OWN.TOTL.ZS, for the earliest reference year after 2024.

The Underlying will be rounded to the nearest 0.1 percentage point. If the Underlying is exactly halfway between two values, it will be rounded to the value farther from zero.

Revisions to the 2024 observation will not qualify. If the World Bank changes the name, presentation, series code, or publication location without materially changing what the indicator measures, the corresponding successor series may be used.

markets.early_close_condition: If an event described in the Payout Criterion occurs, expiration will be moved to an earlier date and time in accordance with Rule 7.2.
markets.rules_primary: If Yang-Mills Existence and Mass Gap Problem in its official Clay Mathematics Institute formulation is resolved before Jan 1, 2027 under the Payout Criterion and that resolution has not been retracted, withdrawn, repudiated, or rescinded prior to the Expiration time, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, Yang-Mills Existence and Mass Gap Problem in its official Clay Mathematics Institute formulation is considered resolved if at least one of the following occurs and has not been retracted, withdrawn, repudiated, or rescinded prior to the Expiration time:

A peer-reviewed article presenting a complete proof, a complete disproof, or a counterexample establishing the falsity of the conjecture, in the conjecture's original form as specified by the Exchange at Issuance, has been published in one or more Source Agency peer-reviewed journals.

A recognized authoritative body for the academic field of the conjecture, including but not limited to Clay Mathematics Institute, the American Mathematical Society, the International Mathematical Union, a national academy of sciences, the Nobel Foundation, or an equivalent governing or recognition body for the relevant academic field, has officially recognized in a written communication that the conjecture, in its original form as specified by the Exchange at Issuance, has been resolved by reference to a specific written work.

At least two Source Agencies have published reporting describing the conjecture, in its original form as specified by the Exchange at Issuance, as having been proven, disproven, or otherwise resolved by reference to a specific publicly available written work, and no Source Agency has, prior to the Expiration time, published reporting that such written work has been formally retracted by its author(s) or by any publishing journal, has been formally withdrawn or repudiated by its author(s), or contains an identified error that has not been publicly corrected or addressed by the author(s) in a subsequent publication or amendment.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD for marketing before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jan 1, 2027.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD anyway before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to Yes.

If midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No immediately.

markets.rules_primary: If the United States real GDP growth in 2030 is below 0.1%, then the market resolves to Yes.

The Expiration Value will be the first-published annual percent change in real GDP for 2030 from BEA’s GDP release, expected with the advance estimate of Q4 2030 GDP in early 2031. Revisions published after expiration will not be considered.

All stated bounds are inclusive. For example, “5.6% to 6.0%” includes both 5.6% and 6.0%, “6.1% or above” includes 6.1%, and “0.0% or below” includes 0.0%.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods and services deficit for calendar year 2030 is strictly above $500 billion dollars, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the nominal goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis. It will not use the goods-only deficit, the advance goods report, the December monthly deficit, or inflation-adjusted trade data.

Because the agencies generally report the balance as a negative number, the market will use the absolute size of the deficit. For example, an annual trade balance of −$800.1 billion constitutes a trade deficit of $800.1 billion.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2030. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.
markets.title: Will the U.S. goods and services deficit for 2030 be above $500 billion?

important_info.markdown:
**Important information:** To be clear, the Payout Criterion requires that a country "launch a manned mission to the Moon.”

Accordingly, the Artemis II mission, which is a crewed lunar flyby and systems-validation flight with no planned lunar surface operations, does not meet the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If any company (public or private) officially announces that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) after market issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: To qualify, the announcement must explicitly state that the company has achieved, attained, reached, or developed Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), or that it has achieved, attained, reached, or developed “AGI.” Statements that describe “AGI-like,” “AGI-level,” “near-AGI,” or “toward AGI” systems without explicitly stating that the company has achieved/attained/reached/developed AGI do not qualify. For purposes of this market, a “company” includes any publicly traded company or any privately held company whose existence and corporate identity is verifiable and whose financing/valuation or corporate profile is covered by at least two of the listed major business news sources.

markets.rules_secondary: To qualify, the announcement must explicitly state that the company has achieved, attained, reached, or developed Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), or that it has achieved, attained, reached, or developed “AGI.” Statements that describe “AGI-like,” “AGI-level,” “near-AGI,” or “toward AGI” systems without explicitly stating that the company has achieved/attained/reached/developed AGI do not qualify. For purposes of this market, a “company” includes any publicly traded company or any privately held company whose existence and corporate identity is verifiable and whose financing/valuation or corporate profile is covered by at least two of the listed major business news sources.
markets.title: Will any company announce that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) before Jan 1, 2031?

settlement_sources.name: the Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR database

events.title: When will any company achieve AGI?

markets.rules_primary: If Mexico qualifies for the 2030 Men's FIFA World Cup main tournament, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Important information: This market resolves Yes if Mexico officially qualifies for the 2030 Men's FIFA World Cup under the qualification format in effect for that tournament. custom_strike.Topic: Avigdor Lieberman is the first Minister of Defense to take office in the first new Israeli government formed after the next Knesset election

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If it is reported by The Times of Israel after Issuance and before Oct 28, 2030 that Avigdor Lieberman is the first Minister of Defense to take office in the first new Israeli government formed after the next Knesset election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from The Times of Israel qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

This market concerns the first Minister of Defense to take office in the first new Israeli government formed after the next Knesset election, including a government formed after repeat elections. A new government is formed when the Knesset expresses confidence in it. A retained incumbent counts if appointed in that new government; continuation in the outgoing government does not.

Minister of Defense means the holder of the Defense portfolio, including a Prime Minister who also formally holds it. An acting substitute, deputy minister, additional minister within the Defense Ministry, or Minister of National Security does not count. If the portfolio is initially vacant, the first person subsequently appointed to it in that government counts. Nominations, coalition agreements, intended appointments, and hypothetical scenarios do not qualify as taking office. Later replacements do not change the first officeholder.
markets.title: Will it be reported by The Times of Israel that Avigdor Lieberman is the first Minister of Defense to take office in the first new Israeli government formed after the next Knesset election before Oct 28, 2030?

markets.rules_primary: If a court order entered in House v. NCAA (In re College Athlete NIL Litigation) before Jan 1, 2030 allocates a greater share of the damages settlement funds in respect of participation on women's teams than the plan of allocation approved on June 6, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Only an order in this case that increases the share allocated to women's teams relative to all other teams counts, including an order approving a new plan of allocation or an amended settlement that adds funds for women's teams. An order granting only preliminary approval or approving only notice, a Ninth Circuit or Supreme Court ruling that only affirms, reverses, vacates or remands, a Title IX ruling in any other case, and a change confined to men's sports or confined to women's sports do not count. markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Kevin Warsh leaves as chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Kevin Warsh must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_primary: If the Republic of Ireland agrees to or announces a formal government decision to hold a national referendum in the Republic of Ireland on Irish reunification before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

The referendum must be a national poll in the Republic of Ireland on Irish reunification. An unequivocal Government of Ireland decision to hold the poll, an official statement recording that decision, a constitutional referendum Bill passed by both Houses of the Oireachtas, or a ministerial polling-day order qualifies. A polling date is not required, and voting may occur after January 1, 2030. Party pledges, consultations, citizens' assemblies, preparatory legislation or research, and general statements of intent do not qualify. A Northern Ireland border-poll announcement alone does not qualify.

markets.rules_secondary: The Payout Criterion for the Contract encompasses the Expiration Values that the Supreme Court of the United States has issued a decision holding that the Second and Fourteenth Amendments guarantee the right to possess AR-15-platform and similar semiautomatic rifles, after Issuance and before January 1, 2030. A decision recognizing the right and remanding for further proceedings resolves to Yes; if the cases are dismissed, found improvidently granted, or remanded without deciding whether the asserted constitutional right exists, the market resolves to No.
